title: Claude Agent SDK vs OpenAI Agents SDK: A 2026 Comparison
excerpt: Subagents vs handoffs, permission modes vs guardrails: a docs-verified look at where the Claude Agent SDK and OpenAI Agents SDK actually diverge.
focus_keyword: claude agent sdk vs openai agents sdk
seo_title: Claude Agent SDK vs OpenAI Agents SDK: A 2026 Comparison
meta_description: A hands-on Claude Agent SDK vs OpenAI Agents SDK comparison: subagents vs handoffs, permission modes vs guardrails, and where each one breaks.
social_message:
Spent a day building the same support-router agent twice: once on the Claude Agent SDK, once on the OpenAI Agents SDK.

They solve delegation completely differently. Claude spawns isolated parallel subagents (up to 20 at once, 3 layers deep). OpenAI hands the whole conversation off to the next agent instead. I also hit a real gotcha: a bare allow-rule can silently skip your own safety callback.

Read the full guide 👉 https://www.firstevolvenextscale.com/claude-agent-sdk-vs-openai-agents-sdk/
